title: Wikipedia articles
description: The articles dataset and the run summary.

dataset.title: Articles
dataset.description: One row per article. Paid rows carry the article fields and billable true; every other row is a free status row with a reason and no article data. Status rows are written in batches of up to 100, so sort by actorIndex to get the input order back.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters of the run: requested, attempted, delivered, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnverified, chargeUncertain, cutByLimit, byStatus, counterMismatch, stopReason, datasetNote, firstFailure and priceNote. The bare RUN_SUMMARY lives in the default store of the run; a copy under RUN_SUMMARY-<runId> is kept in the named store wikipedia-article-summary so two runs do not overwrite each other.
